notes.subject: אל תשחת
notes.rationale: 'Al-tashet' — ol i tingting em i nem bilong singsing (walples bilong ol singsing bilong taim), o em i tok bilong Deivid (Save no ken kilim man i no gat win) — JPS i holim olsem nem bilong singsing.

notes.subject: למנצח
notes.rationale: Hibru i tok wanem long wanpela man i save lidim/lukautim ol miusik; Tok Pisin i brum long en olsem 'man i save lidim'.

translation: Bilong man i save lidim; No Ken Bagarapim; mizmor bilong Asaf, singsing.
